job.title: Credit Controller
job.description:
This is an opportunity to join a long-established, secure business with a strong reputation and a friendly, experienced team. The role will suit someone who enjoys building customer relationships, managing their own workload and being part of a collaborative environment. Warner Recruitment are delighted to be partnering exclusively with Heygates Ltd to recruit a Credit Controller in Bugbrooke Northamptonshire.

Credit Controller
The Role

You'll take responsibility for a varied sales ledger, working closely with customers and colleagues to ensure accounts are managed effectively and payments are collected in a professional and customer-focused manner.

Working with a diverse customer base within the agricultural sector, you'll build strong relationships whilst helping to maintain healthy cash flow and exceptional customer service.

Credit Controller Key Responsibilities
  • Chasing overdue payments and reducing outstanding debt
  • Allocating payments and maintaining the sales ledger
  • Reconciling accounts and resolving queries
  • Setting up new customer accounts
  • Agreeing payment plans where required
  • Processing Direct Debits and cash postings
  • Completing credit checks and assessing customer risk
  • Managing pro forma orders and securing payment
  • Liaising with customers and internal teams
  • Maintaining accurate account records and documentation
About You
We're looking for someone who is:
  • Experienced in Credit Control
  • Confident communicating with customers by phone and email
  • Organised, accurate and detail-focused
  • Proactive and dependable
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team
  • Able to build positive relationships and provide excellent customer service
What's on Offer?
  • 24 days holiday
  • Contributory pension (after 3 months)
  • Friendly and supportive team environment
  • Stable, well-established and financially secure employer
  • Varied and engaging workload
  • On-site parking
  • Long-term career stability within a respected local business
Apply Now
If you're looking for a Credit Control role with a successful Northamptonshire employer that values teamwork, customer service and long-term commitment, we'd love to hear from you, for more information contact Julie at Warner Recruitment.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Heygates is a successful Northamptonshire family business with its head office based in Bugbrooke. Employing over 1,400 people across its operations, the Group is recognised as one of the UK's leading flour milling businesses and is now seeking an experienced Accountant to join its established finance team of 15.
Supplying major food manufacturers, supermarket bakeries and independent craft bakers nationwide, Heygates plays an important role in the British food supply chain and has built a reputation for quality, reliability and exceptional customer service.
Combining strong family values with commercial success, the business offers a stable and supportive working environment where many employees enjoy long and rewarding careers. You'll be joining a friendly, knowledgeable and experienced team with impressive long service across the organisation.

The Role:
Are you an experienced Accountant with a strong background in producing monthly and management accounts, along with clear and meaningful reporting for senior stakeholders?
Whether you hold an ACA, ACC, CIMA or have built your expertise through hands-on experience, we'd love to hear from you.
This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll work closely with and support the Senior Accountant as part of a friendly, collaborative finance team.

Accountant
Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Preparing and presenting management accounts
  • Producing the Profit & Loss account for the Group’s largest subsidiary, with turnover of approximately £250m
  • Completing Balance Sheet reconciliations
  • Providing financial analysis and insight to support business decision-making
  • Supporting with quarter-end reporting
  • Managing VAT returns and supporting tax compliance
  • Supporting projects, including the implementation of a new fixed asset system
  • Reviewing processes and recommending improvements where appropriate
  • Preparing financial and management reports
  • Coding and processing invoices
  • Approving payment runs
  • Providing systems support and troubleshooting where required
  • Supporting other departments with financial guidance and information
  • Preparing National Statistics reports
The person:
You will be well suited to this role if you are:

  • Confident producing a full set of accounts
  • Strong in accounting principles and practice
  • Proactive, practical and solutions-focused
  • Accurate, organised and detail-focused
  • Structured in your approach to work
  • Confident using Excel
Benefits:
  • Contributory pension
  • 24 days holiday + public holidays
  • Free on-site parking
This is a Warner Exclusive retained role with Warner Recruitment Ltd.

If you would like to find out more about this opportunity, please contact Julie at Warner Recruitment. We would be delighted to tell you more.

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
Heygates is a successful Northamptonshire family business with its head office based in Bugbrooke. Employing over 1,400 people across its operations, the Group is recognised as one of the UK's leading flour milling businesses and is now seeking an Assistant Accountant to join its established finance team of 15.
Supplying major food manufacturers, supermarket bakeries and independent craft bakers nationwide, Heygates plays an important role in the British food supply chain and has built a reputation for quality, reliability and exceptional customer service.
Combining strong family values with commercial success, the business offers a stable and supportive working environment where many employees enjoy long and rewarding careers. You'll be joining a friendly, knowledgeable and experienced team with impressive long service across the organisation.

Assistant Accountant
The Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an AAT-qualified accounting professional looking to broaden their experience and develop their career within a supportive finance environment. Whether you're already studying towards ACA, ACCA or CIMA, or considering taking that next step, you'll receive training and exposure to a wide range of accounting responsibilities.
Working closely with colleagues across the finance team, you'll gain hands-on experience across both transactional and month-end accounting activities. Your responsibilities will include supporting financial reporting, reconciliations, budgeting and analysis, whilst helping to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the finance function.

You'll become involved in:
  • Preparing reconciliations, accruals and financial analysis to support monthly reporting
  • Maintaining accurate financial records, including cash books, invoice processing and sales ledger activities
  • Supporting the production of budgets, cost reports and profitability analysis
  • Assisting with VAT-related duties, intercompany accounting and stock valuations
  • Processing expenses, mileage claims and payment checks
  • Contributing to profit and loss reporting and wider management information
  • Providing support across the wider finance team when required
About You
We're looking for someone who:
  • Is AAT qualified
  • May be studying, or interested in studying, towards ACA, ACCA or CIMA (or equivalent)
  • Has previous experience within an accounting/ as an Assistant Accountant
  • Possesses strong numerical and analytical skills
  • Has good Excel skills and attention to detail
  • Is organised, reliable and eager to learn
  • Enjoys working as part of a team
What's on Offer?
  • Full training and ongoing development
  • 24 days holiday
  • Exposure to a broad range of accounting responsibilities
  • Supportive and experienced finance team
  • Long-term career development opportunities within a successful and stable business
For more information, please contact Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment.

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:
If you're looking for a varied finance role where you can build your experience, gain exposure to month-end accounting and develop towards a future Management Accountant position, this could be an excellent next step in your career.
You'll be joining a friendly, hardworking and experienced finance team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys learning, wants to take on increasing responsibility and is keen to build a long-term career within finance.
If you have previous experience as an Accounts Assistant/ Assistant Accountant and are looking for your next step, we’d love to hear from you.
This is a full-time office-based position, Monday to Friday, the successful candidate must live within an easy commute of Northampton.

Key Responsibilities
  • Balance sheet reconciliations
  • Accruals and prepayments
  • Journal postings
  • Fixed asset register maintenance
  • Month-end reporting
  • Production of profit and loss reports
  • Variance analysis and reporting
  • Intrastat reporting
  • Supporting the preparation of management accounts
  • Making recommendations based on financial analysis
  • Assisting with purchase ledger activities
  • Cashiering duties
  • Working with complex Excel spreadsheets and financial data
About You
You may be:
  • AAT qualified or studying AAT
  • An Accounting & Finance graduate
  • Studying towards ACCA, CIMA or ACA
  • Experienced within an Accounts Assistant or Assistant Accountant role
You'll also have:
  • Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookups and data analysis
  • Good communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • The ability to work independently and manage your workload effectively
  • A positive and proactive approach to learning
Benefits
  • 23 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Free on-site parking
If you're looking for a role where you can gain valuable experience, develop your accounting skills and take the next step in your finance career, we'd love to hear from you.
For a confidential discussion, please contact Julie at Warner Recruitment. We look forward to hearing from you.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Whether you're an experienced Accountant, qualified by experience (QBE); studying towards a qualification, newly qualified ACA, ACCA or CIMA, or already established in your accounting career.  This is an opportunity to join a successful and stable business where your experience and contribution will be highly valued.
If you enjoy producing management accounts, analysing financial performance and being part of a supportive finance team, we'd love to hear from you.
You’ll be joining a friendly, experienced finance team where your contribution will be valued as you help keep the day-to-day accounting running smoothly.

The Role
This is a varied and hands-on accounting role within a collaborative team. You'll take responsibility for key financial activities within this business, helping to ensure the accounts are accurate, timely and well managed.

Accountant
Key Responsibilities
  • Preparing monthly management accounts
  • Producing profit and loss accounts for a high-turnover business division
  • Completing balance sheet reconciliations
  • Preparing VAT returns and quarter-end reporting
  • Providing financial analysis and management information
  • Supporting operational departments with financial guidance
  • Assisting with system improvements and ad hoc finance projects
Who This Role Would Suit
We're keen to hear from candidates who have solid accounting experience, whether gained through hands-on experience in a similar role.
You may be:
  • Qualified by Experience (QBE)
  • AAT qualified, part-qualified or studying towards ACA, ACCA or CIMA
  • Newly qualified or experienced in your accounting career
You'll likely:
  • Have experience producing management accounts and supporting month-end processes
  • Enjoy taking ownership of your work and seeing tasks through to completion
  • Be comfortable analysing financial data and identifying trends
  • Have strong Excel skills and attention to detail
  • Be a team player who enjoys building relationships across the business
  • Be looking for a stable, long-term opportunity with a successful employer
Most importantly, you'll bring practical accounting knowledge, attention to detail and a willingness to support the day-to-day finance function.
Benefits
  • 23 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Free parking
  • Friendly and experienced finance team
  • Stable and supportive working environment
  • Opportunity to contribute to projects and process improvements
Interested?
We're keen to speak with experienced accountants from a variety of backgrounds. Professional qualifications are welcomed but are not essential. What matters most is your ability to produce accurate financial information, work collaboratively and add value to the wider business.
If you're looking for a hands-on accounting role within a stable and supportive business, where you can use your experience in a practical, day-to-day finance role, we'd love to hear from you.
Please contact Julie at Warner Recruitment for a confidential discussion.
